import ast

p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    patterns = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == 0:
                c += 1
                continue
            start = c
            while c < w and row[c] != 0:
                c += 1
            run = row[start:c]
            if len(run) >= 2:
                patterns.append(run)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        nonzero = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]
        if len(nonzero) != 1:
            continue
        c = nonzero[0]
        color = row[c]
        pattern = next((run for run in patterns if color in run), None)
        if pattern is None:
            continue
        i = pattern.index(color)
        left = c - i
        for j, value in enumerate(pattern):
            target = left + j
            if 0 <= target < w:
                out[r][target] = value
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
